text:
Alex: Heads-up, mkdocs build on #docs failing in staging due to links with percent-encoded hashes not matching generated ids. Example: `/guides/setup#section%20name` -> fragment `section name` but site slugifier produced `section-name` so link doesn't jump. PR up?
Priya: Ah yeah saw that locally. It's the new frontend sanitizer that decodes `%20` before slugify. We should decode only for display, not for fragment matching.
Jordan: Proposed fix: normalize incoming link fragments with slugify flow before matching. I left a quick patch in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 — please review.
Alex: thx. CI currently failing on an unrelated code fence render around SDK snippet — looks like triple backticks with language `yaml` inside an indented list. Error: `CodeBlockParser: unmatched fence` in mkdocs build.
Elena: I can take the code fence cleanup. Quick grep shows `docs/examples/quickstart.md: lines ~120-130` has mixed indentation. Will open a small PR to reflow.
Priya: Also spotted several image alt texts that are empty causing linkcheck warnings. Not critical but will tidy in same PR (alt text: `![ ](path)` -> `![architecture diagram](...)`).
DocsBot: buildkite/docs-site #874 failed — mkdocs-linkcheck: 27 warnings, 3 errors. See logs: <link>
Jordan: After patching normalizer and the fence fix, we should re-run `mkdocs serve` and `mkdocs build --strict` locally. Commands I ran:
``
pipx run mkdocs build --strict -v
python -m mkdocs.commands.build --config-file mkdocs.yml
``
Alex: @Priya @Elena can you coordinate to bundle the small markdown whitespace and alt text fixes into one PR so we only rerun the linkcheck once? If you prefer separate PRs, I'll queue them defensively.
Elena: I'll open one PR for code fence + alt text (WIP). @Jordan please hold the slug fix until we confirm we don't break existing deep links.
Jordan: Will add tests for decoding->slugify mapping, and a changelog note: "normalize link fragments to slugified ids to avoid percent-encoding mismatches".
Alex: Sounds good. TL;DR: Jordan PR 462 for fragment normalize (review), Elena PR 463 for markdown reflow & alt-text. I'll re-run CI once both merged. :shipit: 
DocsBot: PR 462 CI: pending; PR 463 CI: created
Priya: pinging docs-team for quick reviews, this is blocking a customer migration guide. @here :warning: 
Alex: Thanks team — let's keep the fixes minimal and leave a migration note in the changelog for any external links that relied on decoded fragments.
